caveats: All ten businesses are independent auto repair shops in North Brunswick; eight of ten have no website at all, which is the dominant finding of this batch.

Ratings and review counts were read from public Google Maps place pages on 2026-11-12 and move over time; directory sites (loc8nearme, Birdeye, SureCritic) often show different counts for the same shop because they cache older data.
Two addresses conflict between batch sources and Google: High Velocity Auto (521 Cozzens Ln D vs 1184 Cozzens Ln) and Blue Star Car Care Center (old phone 732-940-0558 vs current 732-658-6300).
Where a Google place page rendered a 'limited view' (Brunswick Auto Craft, Jay Auto Service) no rating or review count was displayed; directory figures are noted instead.
Scores reflect the business, not the industry: small owner-operated shops are scored lower on ability_to_pay even where the gap is large.
Opportunity effort ratings assume a one-person consultancy with standard web/GBP tooling.
data_gaps: naniautorepair.com/robots.txt returned HTTP 406 to our request, so its bot rules could not be read.
Google Business Profile 'services' and Q&A panels were not captured for each listing; findable scores rely on what the public place page rendered.
Jay Auto Service could not be separated from the BP gas-station listing; a separate repair-shop profile may exist under another name.
No phone calls were made and no forms were submitted, so quote turnaround, answer rates and actual booking friction are unverified.
Review text was only skimmed for operational themes; no sentiment analysis was performed and reviews are paraphrased in a few words.

Phone-width screenshots were captured for Carone Auto (home and contact), Castro's (appointments) and Nani (home) and are saved in the task folder; the other seven businesses have no site to screenshot.
